rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
**Equipartition Result:** The average translational kinetic energy per molecule is $\langle KE_{trans} angle = rac{3}{2} k_B T = rac{3}{2} rac{R}{N_A} T$.…
**Temperature Proportionality:** $\langle KE_{trans} angle \propto T$ — absolute temperature is a direct measure of average translational kinetic energy.…

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Internal Energy of Monatomic Gas:** For a monatomic ideal gas, $U = N \langle KE_{trans} angle = rac{3}{2} nRT$. The internal energy is purely translational KE. For diatomic/polyatomic gases, $U$ includes rotational and vibrational contributions as well.
